title: feat(nm2orichy): opposite-pair 1-in 2-out frame orientation at t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Same opposite-pair convention on opposite y-probes: Orient = fail,-1,-1,fail (fail at A because O(A)={+e_2,-e_3} has no opposite pair; fail at D because split fails). Reverse fail, face fail while split reverse HOLDs - shows the frame sign is strictly finer than the split it is built on.
